---
title: "Map"
---

The first maps cover County Louth and County Dublin. Each puts every likely Catholic Church site in the county on one map, from open data: OpenStreetMap, the National Inventory of Architectural Heritage, the Department of Education school lists and institutions named in the official reports. The Dublin map also draws on the four Dublin councils' Records of Protected Structures.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Every point is a grade D lead
A point says *where* a church, convent or school is, not *who owns it*. No open dataset records ownership. Each site still has to be checked against its Land Registry folio before it moves up the evidence grades; see [Method](method.qmd).
:::

Choose a county, then toggle sources in the layer list. Click a point for its source record.

::: {.panel-tabset}
